_comment: Shared app catalog for JBTheatreTools. Both the macOS (SwiftUI) and Windows (WinForms) launchers bundle this file and resolve the per-OS/arch asset by exact name. Keep in sync with each tool's release asset names. Platform keys: macos, windows-x64, windows-arm64. macOS assets are .zip bundles containing a .app; Windows assets are self-contained single-file .exe. The `self` object describes JBTheatreTools' own releases, used for the launcher's self-update check. `downloadServer` is the built-in relay base URL for the default passphrase auth mode (the endpoint requires the suite passphrase; a user-invisible override exists in local settings if this URL ever moves). Sixteen apps listed; Each app entry may carry optional `whatsNew` + `whatsNewVersion` strings (a one-line what's-new for its current release, shown under the app in both launchers; omitted for apps with no release yet). asset names must match each tool's release assets exactly (an app with no published release yet simply shows 'No release' until its first build ships).

self.whatsNew: Apps now show what's new in their latest version.

apps.name: HELO Control
apps.blurb: Control AJA HELO stream / record encoders.
apps.whatsNew: Start/stop streaming from the app, and over OSC.

apps.name: Cisco Switch Tools
apps.blurb: Back up & manage Cisco CBS350 / SG switches over SSH.
apps.whatsNew: Custom output folders are now sanitised before writing.

apps.name: Cisco Brother Labels
apps.blurb: Generate Brother P-touch port labels from Cisco switch configs.
apps.whatsNew: Warns when labels are dropped or a file has none.

apps.name: Machine Inventory
apps.blurb: Collect hardware / software inventory from show machines.
apps.whatsNew: Maintenance and reliability release; no functional changes.

apps.name: Network Port Map
apps.blurb: Map network switch ports to the devices plugged into them.
apps.whatsNew: Maintenance and build-hardening release; no functional changes.

apps.name: Projector Control
apps.blurb: Control theatre projectors over PJLink (Panasonic / Epson).
apps.whatsNew: Switch a projector's input source from the app.

apps.name: Show Dashboard
apps.blurb: Generate a Node-RED show-control dashboard for a production.
apps.whatsNew: New L-Acoustics amp control, plus custom device groups.

apps.name: Show Handbook
apps.blurb: Generate a per-show video handbook document.
apps.whatsNew: Cleaner page breaks and fully generic boilerplate.

apps.name: PSN Tools
apps.blurb: Monitor, visualise, generate & record PosiStageNet (PSN) tracking data.
apps.whatsNew: Change any setting while it's running — no restart.

apps.name: DMX Tools

apps.name: Desk Convert
apps.blurb: Convert digital mixing-console show files between manufacturers (DiGiCo ↔ Yamaha).
apps.whatsNew: Now writes Yamaha bus names; fixed a startup crash.

apps.name: NDI Tools
apps.blurb: Discover NDI video sources on the network and check their health & bandwidth.

apps.name: PowerCalc
apps.blurb: Plan power distribution, balance the phases & print a load sheet.

apps.name: Show Control Tools
apps.blurb: Monitor & translate OSC, MIDI and MSC show-control messages.

apps.name: ShowNet Scanner
apps.blurb: Discover every device on a show network in one live inventory.

apps.name: Timecode Tools
apps.blurb: Monitor, generate, convert & compare LTC, MTC and Art-Net timecode.
